# k0rdent_address_pools (Data Source)

Every AddressPool in a region.

Pools are operator-authored and there is no published list, so without this the only way to fill in a subnet's `address_pool` is to be told the URI.

Region-scoped, not project-scoped: a pool serves every project in its region.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The AddressPools a region gives subnet CIDRs from. Set `only_routable` if
# the subnet needs `allocate_gateway`.

data "k0rdent_address_pools" "all" {}

locals {
  # Active pools that can give a /24: each pool's self_link, keyed by id. A
  # map's keys sort, so the pick below is stable.
  pools_for_a_24 = {
    for p in data.k0rdent_address_pools.all.address_pools : p.id => p.self_link
    if p.state == "active" && p.min_prefix_length <= 24 && p.max_prefix_length >= 24
  }
}

# `self_link`, not `id`, is what a subnet's `address_pool` takes.
resource "k0rdent_subnet" "pods" {
  id      = "pods"
  network = "training-fabric"

  # The first matching pool. try() gives "" when there's none, so the
  # precondition below reports it instead of an index error.
  address_pool  = try(values(local.pools_for_a_24)[0], "")
  prefix_length = 24

  lifecycle {
    precondition {
      condition     = length(local.pools_for_a_24) > 0
      error_message = "No active AddressPool in this region serves a /24."
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `display_name_regex` (String) Return only the pools whose `display_name` matches this regular expression, in the RE2 syntax Terraform's own `regex` function takes. The match isn't anchored, so `prod` finds `preprod-a`: write `^prod-` for a prefix. One with no `display_name` never matches. Filtered in the provider, after the whole list is read: the list operation takes no such filter. **Constraints:** Must be a regular expression in RE2 syntax.
- `only_routable` (Boolean) Return only pools whose subnets are reachable from outside the tenant VPC. Filtered in the provider, because the list operation takes no filter, so every pool is fetched either way.
- `region` (String) Region to read. Defaults to the provider's `region`. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.
- `state` (String) Return only the pools whose `state` is this value. Filtered in the provider, after the whole list is read: the list operation takes no such filter. **Constraints:** Value must be one of: ["creating" "active" "updating" "deleting" "failed"].

### Read-Only

- `address_pools` (Attributes List) The pools, sorted by `id`. The order survives a reorder upstream but not an insertion: a new pool sorting ahead of the others shifts every index after it, so reach for `for_each` rather than `[0]`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--address_pools))
- `ids` (List of String) Just the ids, for `for_each` and `contains`. Sorted by `id`, the same order as `address_pools`.

<a id="nestedatt--address_pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `address_pools`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Free-form text describing it, for people to read.
- `display_name` (String) Human-friendly name, for display only.
- `exclude_ranges` (List of String) Addresses inside `prefixes` the operator has reserved. A subnet allocated from this pool will never contain them. Sorted lexically by range.
- `id` (String) The pool's name.
- `ip_version` (String) IP family of every prefix in the pool. IPv4 only, today.
- `max_prefix_length` (Number) Largest `prefix_length` a subnet may ask this pool for. Defaults to `30` on IPv4; `/32` is permitted where the operator has raised it, for a single-host case such as a control-plane VIP.
- `min_prefix_length` (Number) Smallest `prefix_length` a subnet may ask this pool for. Defaults to `8` on IPv4.
- `prefixes` (List of String) The blocks subnets are allocated from. Sorted lexically by prefix.
- `routable` (Boolean) Whether subnets from this pool are reachable from outside the tenant VPC. A subnet's `allocate_gateway` only takes effect on a routable pool.
- `self_link` (String) Platform-defined reference to this pool. **This is the value a `k0rdent_subnet` takes as its `address_pool`.**
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state. A pool that is not `active` cannot be allocated from.
